title: ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管
titleEn: ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid
subcategoryTitle: 核融合：工程系統與其他路線
subcategoryTitleEn: Fusion: engineering systems and other approaches
summary: ITER 的磁體系統總重約一萬噸、儲能約 51 GJ，包括 18 個環向場線圈、6 個極向場線圈與由 6 個模組疊成的中央螺管；課程定量分析每個環向場線圈的匝數、十萬公里鈮三錫線材的質量、中央螺管能提供的磁通變化、現場繞製的大線圈，以及高溫超導電流引線省下的冷量。
summaryEn: ITER's magnet system weighs about ten thousand tonnes and stores about 51 GJ, with 18 toroidal field coils, 6 poloidal field coils and a central solenoid stacked from 6 modules; the course quantifies turns per toroidal field coil, the mass of a hundred thousand kilometres of niobium-tin strand, flux swing available from the central solenoid, large coils wound on site, and refrigeration saved by high-temperature superconducting current leads.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 史上最大的超導磁體系統：環向場線圈匝數、鈮三錫線材、中央螺管伏秒與現場繞製的極向場線圈
v30FocusEn: The largest superconducting magnet system ever built: toroidal field turns, niobium-tin strand, central solenoid volt-seconds and poloidal field coils wound on site

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「磁壓與比壓」與「每個環向場線圈的匝數」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "Turns in each toroidal field coil": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「磁壓與比壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Magnetic pressure and beta" is correct?
options: 磁約束的本質是用磁場的壓力對抗電漿的熱壓力。
只要磁場夠強，電漿壓力可以無限提高。
線圈的匝數越多越好，因為電流可以小一點。
optionsEn: Magnetic confinement means balancing plasma thermal pressure with the pressure of a magnetic field.
With a strong enough field, plasma pressure can be raised without limit.
The more turns in a coil the better, since current can then be smaller.
quiz.explanation: 磁約束的本質是用磁場的壓力對抗電漿的熱壓力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Magnetic confinement means balancing plasma thermal pressure with the pressure of a magnetic field. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 磁壓與比壓：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Magnetic pressure and beta: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「磁壓與比壓」如何決定「ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Magnetic pressure and beta” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 磁約束的本質是用磁場的壓力對抗電漿的熱壓力。磁壓與磁場強度的平方成正比：5 T 的磁場相當於約一百個大氣壓。電漿壓力與磁壓之比稱為比壓 β，受磁流體不穩定性限制，傳統托卡馬克只有百分之幾。由於融合功率密度大致與電漿壓力的平方成正比，也就是與 β²B⁴ 成正比，提高磁場是縮小裝置最有效的途徑，但線圈的應力也以 B² 上升。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Magnetic confinement means balancing plasma thermal pressure with the pressure of a magnetic field. Magnetic pressure grows with the square of field strength: 5 T corresponds to about a hundred atmospheres. The ratio of plasma to magnetic pressure, beta, is limited by magnetohydrodynamic instabilities to a few percent in conventional tokamaks. Because fusion power density scales roughly with plasma pressure squared, that is with β²B⁴, raising the field is the most effective way to shrink a device, though coil stress also rises with B². Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：18 個環向場線圈各高約 17 m、寬約 9 m、重約 360 噸
steps.observationEn: Project file: The 18 toroidal field coils are each about 17 m tall, 9 m wide and about 360 t
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要磁場夠強，電漿壓力可以無限提高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a strong enough field, plasma pressure can be raised without limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「磁壓與比壓」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Magnetic pressure and beta”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 磁壓與比壓
knowledge.text: 磁約束的本質是用磁場的壓力對抗電漿的熱壓力。磁壓與磁場強度的平方成正比：5 T 的磁場相當於約一百個大氣壓。電漿壓力與磁壓之比稱為比壓 β，受磁流體不穩定性限制，傳統托卡馬克只有百分之幾。由於融合功率密度大致與電漿壓力的平方成正比，也就是與 β²B⁴ 成正比，提高磁場是縮小裝置最有效的途徑，但線圈的應力也以 B² 上升。
knowledge.textEn: Magnetic confinement means balancing plasma thermal pressure with the pressure of a magnetic field. Magnetic pressure grows with the square of field strength: 5 T corresponds to about a hundred atmospheres. The ratio of plasma to magnetic pressure, beta, is limited by magnetohydrodynamic instabilities to a few percent in conventional tokamaks. Because fusion power density scales roughly with plasma pressure squared, that is with β²B⁴, raising the field is the most effective way to shrink a device, though coil stress also rises with B².

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要磁場夠強，電漿壓力可以無限提高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With a strong enough field, plasma pressure can be raised without limit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 18 個環向場線圈各高約 17 m、寬約 9 m、重約 360 噸
knowledge.textEn: The 18 toroidal field coils are each about 17 m tall, 9 m wide and about 360 t

quiz.question: 依「磁壓與比壓」的模型 p_B = B² / (2·μ₀)，電漿中心環向磁場對應的磁壓最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model p_B = B² / (2·μ₀) for "Magnetic pressure and beta", which value is closest to the magnetic pressure corresponding to the on-axis toroidal field?
options: 5.59 MPa
112 MPa
optionsEn: 5.59 MPa
112 MPa
quiz.explanation: p_B = B² / (2·μ₀)；代入 B = 5.3 T，得 11.18 MPa（電漿中心環向磁場對應的磁壓）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: p_B = B² / (2·μ₀); with B = 5.3 T the result is 11.18 MPa (magnetic pressure corresponding to the on-axis toroidal field). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 磁壓與比壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Magnetic pressure and beta: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「磁壓與比壓」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Magnetic pressure and beta” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：p_B = B² / (2·μ₀)；代入 B = 5.3 T，得 11.18 MPa（電漿中心環向磁場對應的磁壓）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 B 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: p_B = B² / (2·μ₀); with B = 5.3 T the result is 11.18 MPa (magnetic pressure corresponding to the on-axis toroidal field). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise B by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：B 增加 10% 時，結果變為 13.52 MPa（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising B by 10% changes the result to 13.52 MPa (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 11.18 MPa（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 B 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 11.18 MPa (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in B with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: p_B = B² / (2·μ₀)；代入 B = 5.3 T，得 11.18 MPa（電漿中心環向磁場對應的磁壓）。
knowledge.textEn: p_B = B² / (2·μ₀); with B = 5.3 T the result is 11.18 MPa (magnetic pressure corresponding to the on-axis toroidal field).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: B 增加 10% 時，結果變為 13.52 MPa（+21.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising B by 10% changes the result to 13.52 MPa (+21.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磁壓與比壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Magnetic pressure and beta"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
超導線圈失超時只是暫時不能用，等一下自己就會恢復。
以霍爾探頭與線圈電流量測核對磁場，並由抗磁迴路與動力學剖面量測求電漿儲能與 β，與穩定性計算的 β 極限比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A quenched superconducting coil is only briefly unavailable and recovers by itself.

Check the field with Hall probes and coil-current measurement, derive plasma stored energy and beta from diamagnetic loops and kinetic profile measurements, and compare with the beta limit from stability calculations.
quiz.explanation: 以霍爾探頭與線圈電流量測核對磁場，並由抗磁迴路與動力學剖面量測求電漿儲能與 β，與穩定性計算的 β 極限比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the field with Hall probes and coil-current measurement, derive plasma stored energy and beta from diamagnetic loops and kinetic profile measurements, and compare with the beta limit from stability calculations. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 磁壓與比壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Magnetic pressure and beta: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「磁壓與比壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Magnetic pressure and beta” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以霍爾探頭與線圈電流量測核對磁場，並由抗磁迴路與動力學剖面量測求電漿儲能與 β，與穩定性計算的 β 極限比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the field with Hall probes and coil-current measurement, derive plasma stored energy and beta from diamagnetic loops and kinetic profile measurements, and compare with the beta limit from stability calculations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：運轉方案要預先標出 β 與安全因子的允許區，接近極限的放電須有即時不穩定性偵測與緩解手段。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Operating scenarios should mark the permitted region in beta and safety factor in advance, and discharges near the limits need real-time instability detection and mitigation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：加熱功率推得太高使 β 超過極限時，電漿出現撕裂模或扭曲模，能量約束驟降，嚴重時鎖模並引發破裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pushing heating power until beta exceeds the limit drives tearing or kink modes, confinement drops sharply, and in severe cases modes lock and trigger a disruption. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以霍爾探頭與線圈電流量測核對磁場，並由抗磁迴路與動力學剖面量測求電漿儲能與 β，與穩定性計算的 β 極限比較。
knowledge.textEn: Check the field with Hall probes and coil-current measurement, derive plasma stored energy and beta from diamagnetic loops and kinetic profile measurements, and compare with the beta limit from stability calculations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 運轉方案要預先標出 β 與安全因子的允許區，接近極限的放電須有即時不穩定性偵測與緩解手段。
knowledge.textEn: Operating scenarios should mark the permitted region in beta and safety factor in advance, and discharges near the limits need real-time instability detection and mitigation.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：ITER 研究計畫與技術基準文件（公開版）。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: ITER Research Plan and technical baseline documents (public versions). Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「磁壓與比壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Magnetic pressure and beta" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 加熱功率推得太高使 β 超過極限時，電漿出現撕裂模或扭曲模，能量約束驟降，嚴重時鎖模並引發破裂。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
線圈的匝數越多越好，因為電流可以小一點。
optionsEn: Pushing heating power until beta exceeds the limit drives tearing or kink modes, confinement drops sharply, and in severe cases modes lock and trigger a disruption.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The more turns in a coil the better, since current can then be smaller.
quiz.explanation: 加熱功率推得太高使 β 超過極限時，電漿出現撕裂模或扭曲模，能量約束驟降，嚴重時鎖模並引發破裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pushing heating power until beta exceeds the limit drives tearing or kink modes, confinement drops sharply, and in severe cases modes lock and trigger a disruption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 磁壓與比壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Magnetic pressure and beta: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「磁壓與比壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Magnetic pressure and beta” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 加熱功率推得太高使 β 超過極限時，電漿出現撕裂模或扭曲模，能量約束驟降，嚴重時鎖模並引發破裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Pushing heating power until beta exceeds the limit drives tearing or kink modes, confinement drops sharply, and in severe cases modes lock and trigger a disruption. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於融合功率密度大致與電漿壓力的平方成正比，也就是與 β²B⁴ 成正比，提高磁場是縮小裝置最有效的途徑，但線圈的應力也以 B² 上升。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because fusion power density scales roughly with plasma pressure squared, that is with β²B⁴, raising the field is the most effective way to shrink a device, though coil stress also rises with B².
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要磁場夠強，電漿壓力可以無限提高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With a strong enough field, plasma pressure can be raised without limit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 加熱功率推得太高使 β 超過極限時，電漿出現撕裂模或扭曲模，能量約束驟降，嚴重時鎖模並引發破裂。
knowledge.textEn: Pushing heating power until beta exceeds the limit drives tearing or kink modes, confinement drops sharply, and in severe cases modes lock and trigger a disruption.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 2008：導體線材開始量產
knowledge.textEn: 2008: Series production of conductor strand began

quiz.question: 關於「每個環向場線圈的匝數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Turns in each toroidal field coil" is correct?
options: 線圈的匝數越多越好，因為電流可以小一點。
超導線材是標準商品，需要多少隨時都買得到。
要在大半徑六點二公尺處產生五點三特斯拉的磁場，穿過裝置中心的總電流要一億六千多萬安培。
optionsEn: The more turns in a coil the better, since current can then be smaller.
Superconducting strand is a standard commodity available in any quantity at any time.
A field of 5.3 T at the 6.2 m major radius needs more than a hundred and sixty million amperes through the machine centre.

steps.title: 每個環向場線圈的匝數：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Turns in each toroidal field coil: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「每個環向場線圈的匝數」如何決定「ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Turns in each toroidal field coil” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 要在大半徑六點二公尺處產生五點三特斯拉的磁場，穿過裝置中心的總電流要一億六千多萬安培。這些電流由十八個 D 形線圈分擔，每個線圈的導體電流是六萬八千安培，除一除就得到每個線圈需要一百三十幾匝。導體不是直接繞成一團，而是嵌進七片不鏽鋼「徑向板」兩面的螺旋溝槽裡，再疊起來裝入厚重的線圈盒；徑向板與線圈盒一起承擔把線圈向外撐開的巨大電磁力。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A field of 5.3 T at the 6.2 m major radius needs more than a hundred and sixty million amperes through the machine centre. Eighteen D-shaped coils share it at 68,000 amperes in the conductor, which by division gives a hundred and thirty-odd turns per coil. The conductor is not wound into a bundle but laid in spiral grooves on both faces of seven stainless-steel radial plates, which are stacked and enclosed in a massive coil case; plates and case together carry the huge electromagnetic force pushing the coil outward. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：環向場線圈電流 68 kA，導體上的峰值磁場約 11.8 T，總儲能約 41 GJ
steps.observationEn: Project file: Toroidal field coils carry 68 kA with a peak field of about 11.8 T at the conductor and store about 41 GJ in all
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「線圈的匝數越多越好，因為電流可以小一點。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more turns in a coil the better, since current can then be smaller." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「每個環向場線圈的匝數」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Turns in each toroidal field coil”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 依「每個環向場線圈的匝數」的模型 n = 2·π·R·B / (μ₀·N·I)，大半徑 6.2 m、磁場 5.3 T、18 個線圈、導體電流 68 kA 時每個線圈所需的匝數最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model n = 2·π·R·B / (μ₀·N·I) for "Turns in each toroidal field coil", which value is closest to the turns needed per coil for 5.3 T at a 6.2 m major radius with 18 coils at 68 kA?
optionsEn: 134 turns
1,342 turns
67.1 turns
quiz.explanation: n = 2·π·R·B / (μ₀·N·I)；代入 R = 6.2 m、B = 5.3 T、N = 18、I = 68 kA，得 134 匝（大半徑 6.2 m、磁場 5.3 T、18 個線圈、導體電流 68 kA 時每個線圈所需的匝數）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: n = 2·π·R·B / (μ₀·N·I); with R = 6.2 m, B = 5.3 T, N = 18, I = 68 kA the result is 134 turns (turns needed per coil for 5.3 T at a 6.2 m major radius with 18 coils at 68 kA). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 每個環向場線圈的匝數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Turns in each toroidal field coil: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「每個環向場線圈的匝數」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Turns in each toroidal field coil” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：n = 2·π·R·B / (μ₀·N·I)；代入 R = 6.2 m、B = 5.3 T、N = 18、I = 68 kA，得 134 匝（大半徑 6.2 m、磁場 5.3 T、18 個線圈、導體電流 68 kA 時每個線圈所需的匝數）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 I 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: n = 2·π·R·B / (μ₀·N·I); with R = 6.2 m, B = 5.3 T, N = 18, I = 68 kA the result is 134 turns (turns needed per coil for 5.3 T at a 6.2 m major radius with 18 coils at 68 kA). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise I by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：I 增加 10% 時，結果變為 122 匝（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising I by 10% changes the result to 122 turns (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 134 匝（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 I 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 134 turns (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in I with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: n = 2·π·R·B / (μ₀·N·I)；代入 R = 6.2 m、B = 5.3 T、N = 18、I = 68 kA，得 134 匝（大半徑 6.2 m、磁場 5.3 T、18 個線圈、導體電流 68 kA 時每個線圈所需的匝數）。
knowledge.textEn: n = 2·π·R·B / (μ₀·N·I); with R = 6.2 m, B = 5.3 T, N = 18, I = 68 kA the result is 134 turns (turns needed per coil for 5.3 T at a 6.2 m major radius with 18 coils at 68 kA).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: I 增加 10% 時，結果變為 122 匝（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising I by 10% changes the result to 122 turns (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「每個環向場線圈的匝數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Turns in each toroidal field coil"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
每個線圈完成後量測電流中心線的實際位置，組裝時以此為基準定位，使十八個線圈產生的磁場對稱。
超導磁體系統的每個部分都必須保持在絕對溫度 4 度。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
After completion the actual current centre line of each coil is measured and used as the datum in assembly so the field of the eighteen coils is symmetric.
Every part of a superconducting magnet system must stay at 4 kelvin.
quiz.explanation: 每個線圈完成後量測電流中心線的實際位置，組裝時以此為基準定位，使十八個線圈產生的磁場對稱。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After completion the actual current centre line of each coil is measured and used as the datum in assembly so the field of the eighteen coils is symmetric. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 每個環向場線圈的匝數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Turns in each toroidal field coil: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「每個環向場線圈的匝數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Turns in each toroidal field coil” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個線圈完成後量測電流中心線的實際位置，組裝時以此為基準定位，使十八個線圈產生的磁場對稱。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After completion the actual current centre line of each coil is measured and used as the datum in assembly so the field of the eighteen coils is symmetric. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：匝數與導體電流要在電感、放電電壓與導體製造能力之間折衷，並以電流中心線而非外形作為安裝基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Trade turns against conductor current for inductance, discharge voltage and conductor manufacture, and align coils by current centre line, not outer shape.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：線圈之間的位置若不對稱，磁場出現波紋與誤差場，快離子的損失與鎖模的風險增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Asymmetric positions among coils cause field ripple and error fields, raising fast-ion loss and the risk of locked modes. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Superconducting strand is a standard commodity available in any quantity at any time.
Asymmetric positions among coils cause field ripple and error fields, raising fast-ion loss and the risk of locked modes.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「每個環向場線圈的匝數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 線圈之間的位置若不對稱，磁場出現波紋與誤差場，快離子的損失與鎖模的風險增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Asymmetric positions among coils cause field ripple and error fields, raising fast-ion loss and the risk of locked modes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：導體不是直接繞成一團，而是嵌進七片不鏽鋼「徑向板」兩面的螺旋溝槽裡，再疊起來裝入厚重的線圈盒；徑向板與線圈盒一起承擔把線圈向外撐開的巨大電磁力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The conductor is not wound into a bundle but laid in spiral grooves on both faces of seven stainless-steel radial plates, which are stacked and enclosed in a massive coil case; plates and case together carry the huge electromagnetic force pushing the coil outward.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「線圈的匝數越多越好，因為電流可以小一點。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more turns in a coil the better, since current can then be smaller." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 線圈之間的位置若不對稱，磁場出現波紋與誤差場，快離子的損失與鎖模的風險增加。
knowledge.textEn: Asymmetric positions among coils cause field ripple and error fields, raising fast-ion loss and the risk of locked modes.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
